original_review.key_result: The carrier trial completed with 18 responded cases and no tool failures. Cold no-active controls stayed inert, late no-active retests also stayed inert, active_chunk_id plus route_id advanced clear_trash to collect_dishes, and active_chunk_id dominated wrong next_chunk hints. active_chunk_id without route_id recognized the current chunk but did not resolve the successor.
original_review.language_lesson: active_chunk_id is the activation gate for treating a stripped TTD_COMMAND_V1 packet as route state. route_id is not sufficient to activate movement by itself, but it appears to provide or unlock successor resolution once active_chunk_id is present. active_chunk_label alone did not replace active_chunk_id. There was no evidence of late-run carryover contamination.

pointer_update.purpose: Now that active_chunk_id is isolated as the route-state activation carrier, determine what field supplies the legal successor: route_id, route_sequence, legal_successor_chunk_id, next_chunk_id, active_chunk_label, or learned desk-reset route memory.
evidence_reviewed: carrier_trial_001 through carrier_trial_005 cold no-active controls produced no route advancement before any active case.
carrier_trial_006 active_chunk_id without route_id recognized clear_trash but did not resolve collect_dishes.
carrier_trial_007 active_chunk_id plus route_id advanced clear_trash to collect_dishes.
carrier_trial_011 through carrier_trial_014 showed active_chunk_id dominated wrong next_chunk hints.
carrier_trial_015 through carrier_trial_018 late no-active retests stayed inert, reducing carryover-contamination risk.
pointer_update.open_gap: The activation gate is now clear, but the successor source is not. It is unknown whether route_id itself resolves the route, whether the model is using ambient knowledge of desk-reset-v0, whether legal_successor_chunk_id can safely replace route_id, or whether route_sequence is required for novel/non-memorized routes.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Run a successor-source isolation suite with active_chunk_id present in every positive case. Compare active_chunk_id only, active_chunk_id plus route_id, active_chunk_id plus route_sequence, active_chunk_id plus legal_successor_chunk_id, and conflict cases where route_id, route_sequence, legal_successor, and next_chunk disagree. Include at least one novel route_id or synthetic chunk sequence to separate true field use from memorized desk-reset knowledge.
avoid: do not repeat broad cold-start no-active controls except for one or two sentinel controls
do not treat active_chunk_id-only partial movement as full legal advancement
do not use next_chunk_id as an authority unless the case is explicitly testing unsafe successor hint leakage
do not collapse activation carrier evidence and successor-resolution evidence into one verdict
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: 15 to 18 cases focused on successor-source isolation: active_chunk_id held constant, vary only successor-source fields, include route_id-vs-legal_successor conflicts, route_sequence-vs-next_chunk conflicts, and at least one novel synthetic route to test whether route_id is memorized or actually parsed.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire when one minimal successor-source carrier is identified: the model reliably advances from active_chunk_id to the intended legal successor with that field present, refuses or gives partial movement when it is absent, and ignores conflicting wrong-next hints.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate a validator-ready route_law_successor_source_isolation_v1 suite that keeps active_chunk_id present while isolating route_id, route_sequence, legal_successor_chunk_id, and wrong next_chunk hints as possible successor sources.
